_comment: Phase http_ratelimit. Pro: 2 rules; expression fields Host/URI/Path/Full URI/Query/Verified Bot only (no method); characteristics IP only (+ cf.colo.id, required); period up to 60 s; mitigation timeout up to 1 h. This REPLACES the Free-plan 'push API flood' rule - the first rule below is its successor.

rules.expression: (http.host in {"artimer.win" "www.artimer.win"} and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/") and not cf.bot_management.verified_bot)
